title: Compliance quickfires — scratch notes (Lucien Park)
content:
Purpose: rapid-fire questions / micro-mappings while prepping for SOC2 scoping. Not tidy. Use this to remind myself before pairing with Ellie on evidence pulls.

Status snapshot:
- quick draft: scoping + what evidence to ask for from infra and SRE.
- next: convert to formal control-mapping doc, attach samples, push to INF-4821.

High-level scope decisions (notes to discuss):
1) Hosted API + Dedicated customers in scope. Private (on-prem) will be scoped per-customer; treat as out-of-scope for company-level controls unless customer contract requires.
2) Data classification: PII in requests – currently not stored persistently in hosted logs (confirm log-redaction ticket). If true -> lowers evidence volume for retention controls.
3) Key management: Redwood uses cloud KMS for control plane keys, local HSM for Private customers (confirm HSM vendor + certs).

Quick-fire control mapping fragments (working):
- TSC: CC6 (Access Controls) -> Control candidate: IAM org policy + role review cadence. Evidence: IAM policy snapshots (last 3 months), role-rotation notes, access review minutes. Owner: infra.
- TSC: CC7 (Change Mgmt) -> Control candidate: Release gating in CI with approvals + runbook. Evidence: PR history for release 2026-01..03, feature flags used for rollback, postmortems. Owner: release-engineering.
- TSC: CC3 (Logical/Physical) -> Control candidate: Network segmentation for prod VPCs. Evidence: VPC diagrams, firewall rule exports, Terraform state. Owner: platform-engineering.

Evidence wishlist (what to ask teams for, short):
- Last 3 months of IAM role changes (CSV or audit logs) + owner who approved changes.
- Sample of access review email/meeting notes.
- Jenkins/GitHub actions run logs for gate passes for two major releases.
- Terraform apply diffs + runbook referenced at apply time.
- Sample logs demonstrating log-redaction in hosted API (sanitized example).

Unresolved questions (call these out during sync):
- Q1: Do Dedicated nodes have separate monitoring/data retention policies? If yes, are those centrally audited? (ping: SRE)
- Q2: Is telemetry for Private deployments ever routed through Redwood-managed endpoints? Need proof that customer-managed deployments do not share telemetry. (ping: private-deployments eng)
- Q3: How do we demonstrate token/key revocation for ephemeral creds? Example flows: node reboot, key compromise — what artifacts exist?

Control-level micro-risks (brainstorm):
- Over-aggregation: Logs that contain customer input could accidentally get included in debugging bundles — need example redaction scripts and test cases.
- Role sprawl: service accounts created for feature experiments with broad perms. Mitigation: add service-account inventory + last-used timestamp.
- Rollback chains: automatic fallback policies across regions might introduce state desync — need runbook showing safe rollback steps and tests.

Action items (concrete, owner, ETA):
- A1: Ask infra for IAM change export (CSV) for Jan–Mar 2026. Owner: Marta. ETA: 2026-03-08. JIRA: INF-4821 comment.
- A2: Get two sample redacted request logs from hosted-api team (one success, one error). Owner: Ellie. ETA: 2026-03-06.
- A3: Request VPC diagram and terraform state snapshot from platform-eng. Owner: Ramon. ETA: 2026-03-10.
- A4: Draft short control narrative for CC6 and CC7; attach evidence types. Owner: Lucien (me). ETA: 2026-03-07.

Snippet: sample control narrative (raw):
"Control: Role-based access control for production resources is enforced via IAM roles defined in the org Terraform repo. Role changes require an approved PR and a documented justification. Access reviews occur quarterly and are documented in the trust-ops Confluence page. Evidence includes role-change PRs, quarterly review minutes, and IAM audit logs."

Notes-to-self:
- When asking for logs, request both the raw export and a sanitized excerpt to speed reviewer consumption.
- Keep one canonical evidence folder per control in the INF-4821 ticket (zip with README).
- Prioritize CC6 -> CC7 -> CC3 order for evidence collection (most questions come from auditors on access/change).

Potential shortcuts (if timeline tight):
- Use sampling (2 weeks of logs) + engineer attestation for full retention windows.
- Convert internal runbooks into short attestation emails signed by owning manager.

Random brainstorming fragments to revisit:
- Could we add a simple CI job that produces an "IAM diff report" every release? Might solve a lot of evidence churn.
- Consider a small script that proves no customer PII stored in perf traces (hash-check + sample).

End of quickfires. Next steps: pair with Ellie to redact sample logs (block 30m), then draft control narratives and attach evidence to INF-4821.

-- Lucien
